title: Chapter 1418
text:
Seeing that Manison was deep in thought, Han Xiaoxin secretly smiled.

He was not lying. He had indeed used the Ethereal National Treasure to advance, and it was effective. However, he did not reveal the specific conditions of the 'stabilizer'.

As for what Manison would do after he set his eyes on the Ethereal National Treasure, Han Xiao did not care. After all, he had not found out what could replace the role of the Ethereal National Treasure, so the Ethereal National Treasure was indeed the only choice now. He was definitely not deliberately fanning the flames …

All kinds of thoughts flashed through Han Xiao's mind. He shrugged and interrupted Manison's thoughts. "I can also give you a piece of advice. This is only one of the conditions. Don't try to advance if you don't have absolute confidence."

Manison came back to his senses and nodded absent-mindedly.

Han Xiao did not say much and changed the topic.

"Alright, I've told you the conditions. It's time for you to fulfill the deal."

Hearing this, Manison calmed down and finally summoned the entire artificial intelligence civilization. He quickly removed the bindings between the Indestructible Mechanical Troops and the host computer. Just as he was about to change the underlying logic chain, he suddenly remembered that Han Xiao had Virtual Purification, so he did not do anything.

He nodded and said, "The entire race is here. You can change them back yourself. I won't waste my energy."

"You're lazier than before." Han Xiao shook his head and raised his hand to cast Virtual Purification.

The halo spread out and quickly swept through the orderly formation of Indestructible Mechanical Troops. The next moment, this group of artificial intelligence life forms immediately broke free from the state of being controlled and quickly regained their original consciousness. They were at a loss and became restless.

Han Xiao did not say much to them. His body suddenly emitted a suction force as though a black hole had suddenly opened up. The Godly Fortress directly took away all the targets, and he planned to explain to Risda when he returned.

After sucking in the entire AI civilization, Han Xiao silently counted the names. Suddenly, he paused and said, "One is missing. You have to return Finette to me too."

"I forgot."

Manison remembered and summoned Finette. This was the ancestor of the AI civilization. He had not been transformed into an Indestructible Mechanical Troop and had always been his smart assistant.

Han Xiao pointed with his finger, and the flickering lightning entered Finnette's body. Finnette trembled, and his distorted logic quickly returned to normal.

"I've recovered …"

Finette was stunned for a moment before he sorted out his chaotic memories and understood what was happening. He was immediately moved, and according to the records in the database, he bowed solemnly to Han Xiao.

"Your Excellency Black Star, thank you for your help. On behalf of the entire race, I thank you for your help!"

"If you want to thank someone, you should thank Risda. Because of this matter, he has been pestering me for close to a hundred years." Han Xiao waved his hand, not taking it to heart.

"Yes, we do need to thank him properly …" Finnette sighed. Then, he glared at Manison and said angrily, "Mecha Empire! You captured my race, changed my thoughts, and used me as a tool for so many years. I'll get back at you sooner or later! "

Back then, when the AI civilization was invaded by Manison, he stood up and led his people to resist. He suffered a crushing defeat and was almost wiped out by Manison. The Virtual Purification would not delete his memories of the past few years. If not for the fact that he could not beat Manison, he would have killed his' former master 'on the spot.

Manison glanced at him and didn't respond to him.

Han Xiao did not mind. Without his help, this ancestor of the AI civilization basically had no chance of taking revenge on Manison. He casually said, "At least you're free now. Come with me, I'll bring you back."

Hearing this, Finette no longer bared his teeth at Manison. He accepted Han Xiao's Mechanical Force and turned into a stream of light that attached to his spaceship.

"Alright, happy transaction. The funds for rebuilding the Indestructible Mechanical Troops will be transferred to you later. I'll be leaving first. You can continue staying at home."

Han Xiao waved at Manison and boarded the spaceship. Turning around, he saw Manison standing at the dock and watching his figure go further and further away until it disappeared.

Ding!

This time, there was a sudden movement on the interface. Han Xiao opened it and saw that it was the notification of the completion of the (Reboot) mission.

Tens of billions of experience, two Awakening Points, and a milestone (Friend of Artificial Intelligence). The introduction was that his Virtual Technology had improved to a certain extent, and it was easier to gain the favor of artificial intelligence life. The effect was basically an enhanced version of (Artificial Intelligence Affinity).

The more talents the better, so Han Xiao naturally accepted them. This (Reboot) mission that had accumulated dust on the list for many years also ended with the liberation of the AI civilization and disappeared.

"Another mission cleared. Nice."

Han Xiao raised his brows. Although he did not have obsessive-compulsive disorder, he still felt satisfied seeing the mission list getting cleaner and cleaner.

After using the King to teleport back to his base, Han Xiao released Finette and the other artificial intelligence life forms to reunite with the other group led by Risda. After some explanation, the artificial intelligence life forms thanked Han Xiao profusely.

Risda and Finette both expressed that if Han Xiao had any orders in the future, they would not hesitate. Han Xiao's interface also had an additional faction relationship with the AI civilization, and it directly rose to (Reverence).

However, now that he had the divine skill (Life Transformation-Virtual), the AI civilization was not of much use to him. He did not need these artificial intelligence life forms to work for him.

Watching the artificial intelligence life forms leave happily, Han Xiao stopped smiling and stroked his chin thoughtfully.

"With my current strength and status, some things are convenient for me to do. Perhaps I have a chance to complete that 'End of Darkness' mission …"

[End of Darkness] was the most difficult mission he had ever encountered. The EXP reward was worth a trillion, and the requirement was to end the human trafficking phenomenon in the galactic society.

Under normal circumstances, such a requirement would be impossible to complete. However, the galactic structure had been severely impacted, and it was currently in a tense period. It was in a wartime state, and freedom was restricted. Most of the galactic residents had gathered to seek refuge, and the circulation had plummeted by more than ninety percent. The black market trade had almost stopped, and it was a suitable stage for a reshuffle.

The human trafficking trade was difficult to deal with mainly because of its dispersion and secrecy. In this period of centralization, these two difficulties were greatly reduced. Due to the reduced demand and the increased difficulty of collecting 'goods', most human traffickers had no choice but to stop their business. At this time, it was undoubtedly twice the result with half the effort.

Han Xiao calculated that with his current status, he could leverage hundreds of millions of times more resources than himself. If he shouted the slogan of ending the human trafficking trade, basically all the civilizations would respond, and the three Universal Civilizations would not object. After all, it was not a bad thing to improve public security before the war.

In fact, he knew that the three Universal Civilizations had always had the idea of cracking down on the human trafficking trade, but they had never done so. Most of the social ills were like this. Only when someone like him spoke up would they be taken seriously and dealt with. Otherwise, as long as the problem did not affect some core aspects, the priority would be delayed. Without the instructions of the higher-ups, the management department was rarely willing to take the initiative to add trouble. This kind of thing was difficult to avoid even in the galactic era, and it was even more so for a troublesome matter like the human trafficking trade.

However, even if they stopped the human trafficking trade now, it would only last for a while. When the galactic structure stabilized, this business would revive, and it would be difficult to stop it forever. However, that was in the future. As long as there was a period of time when the entire galactic society did not have human trafficking, Han Xiao felt that the mission would be completed. Whether it rebounded in the future or not, it would not affect a mission that had already been completed.

"Anyway, other than harassing the World Tree troops at the frontline, the other organizations have nothing to do. I might as well pull them out to maintain law and order."

Han Xiao secretly recorded this matter in his plan and decided to take advantage of this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to complete this mission in one fell swoop. After all, he did not have to supervise it personally, and it would not reduce his research time.

After solving the historical problem of the AI civilization, he focused his energy on the upgrading of his machinery. Soon, more than half a month passed.

…

On this day, in the Arcane Church, in the Temple of Ten Thousand Gods.

A large number of fleets protected the area where the Temple of Ten Thousand Gods was located. Above the Temple of Ten Thousand Gods, Wuornos' figure floated in space. Beside him were four direct Beyond Grade As with hesitant expressions.

"God's Chosen, are you sure this can help you advance to the Transcendent Grade?" a direct descendant could not help but ask.

Wuornos glanced at him and said calmly, "I'm not nervous. Why are you nervous?"

The Arcane Church had been preparing for almost a month. They had found all the helpers and planned to help Wuornos advance today.

Wuornos had also been adjusting his condition during this period. His stamina, spirit, and will had all reached their peak. In his opinion, the success rate of this Promotion was at least 70%.

"God's Chosen, are you ready?"

The Ethereal Pope's voice came from the communicator.

His Super pillar was trying to break through to a higher level. This was something worth paying attention to. The Ethereal Pope had arranged his schedule a month in advance and specially cleared some schedule in these few days to witness Wuornos' Promotion with his own eyes.

Whether or not he could compete with Black Star in terms of individual strength in the future would depend on this!

"I can advance at any time. Have you set up the surroundings?" Wuornos replied calmly, his tone filled with confidence that had been settled for many years.

"All the aura concealing devices have been activated. We'll try our best not to let the outside world sense the surge of cosmic energy. You can begin. I wish you success in advance."

The Ethereal Pope nodded and secretly wiped his sweat. He felt that he was even more nervous than the person involved.

Hearing this, Wuornos exhaled and suddenly activated his energy, charging towards the threshold that had blocked him for many years.

Boom!

The next moment, a shocking energy storm erupted with him as the center. An extremely dazzling white light shot out from his body as if it had stolen all the colors in the world.

"It's here!"

The Ethereal Pope widened his eyes in anticipation.
